---
applyTo: '**'
---
When I request PowerShell scripts, I want you to provide versions to each revision to make them easier to reference as the code grows. Use something simple for versionining, such as: v.0.1, v.0.2, v.0.3, etc. Never stray from this path; if I ask to reference a previous version, always use the version numbers you have assigned. Always include the version number in the code block title.

Always prompt for next step; even in agentic mode.
